crossRefs.note: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”
Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.
If I had said, “I will speak thus”; behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same…
But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little…

translations.web: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.
translations.bsb: If you do not experience discipline like everyone else, then you are illegitimate children and not true sons.
translations.kjv: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
translations.asv: But if ye are without chastening, whereof all have been made partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
